entities.name: Aristocratic Republic
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Aristocratic Republic, a political institution in Peru during The Guano Age and the War of the Pacific (1884–1900). Grew from Treaty of Ancón — Peru cedes Tarapacá to Chile and Chilean forces capture and occupy Lima — January 1881. Led to the emergence of Postwar Reconstruction and the Aristocratic Republic.
